# ssp_alarm_definitions (Data Source)

Lists alarm definitions matching an optional filter.

Corresponds to `POST /ssp/alarms/definitions`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Filter to alarm definitions with this enabled state.
- `event_types` (List of String) Filter to alarm definitions with these event types.
- `feature_names` (List of String) Filter to alarm definitions for these feature names.
- `severities` (List of String) Filter to alarm definitions with these severities.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Alarm definitions matching the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `event_type` (String)
- `feature_display_name` (String)
- `feature_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `summary` (String)
